description: Source code for a containerd container handler in the cAdvisor project, managing container metrics, specifications, and lifecycle.

classes.name: containerdContainerHandler
classes.description: Handler for managing containerd containers, providing metrics, specs, and lifecycle operations.

methods.name: getFsStats
methods.description: Populates filesystem statistics for the container.

methods.name: ListContainers
methods.description: Lists container references; returns empty in this implementation.

methods.name: GetCgroupPath
methods.description: Returns the cgroup path for a given resource.

methods.name: ListProcesses
methods.description: Lists process IDs within the container.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if the container's cgroup exists.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container; no operation in this implementation.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations; no operation in this implementation.

methods.name: GetContainerIPAddress
methods.description: Returns container IP address; not managed by containerd.

methods.name: GetExitCode
methods.description: Retrieves the container's exit status code.
